title: Suppression of the Marangoni effect by controlling the mixing procedures of the precursor solution to improve the performance of perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00149H, Paper
Yunfei Wang, Lili Shen, Xinyu Chen, Zongqi Chen, Songwang Yang
By optimizing the mixing procedures of the perovskite precursor solution, the Marangoni effect was suppressed, resulting in improved device performance (0.07 cm2 cell from 14.71% to 16.55% and 66 cm2 sub-module from 11.21% to 13.02%).
